title: Northstar equipment handbook
text:
# Returns and refunds
Unopened equipment can be returned within 30 days of delivery. A receipt or order number is required. Opened equipment is eligible only if it is faulty. Refunds use the original payment method and take 5 to 10 business days after inspection.

# Exceptions
Custom engraved equipment cannot be returned unless faulty. Subscription renewals are covered by a separate cancellation policy. Contact support before shipping a battery because transport restrictions apply.

title: Northstar delivery guide
text:
# Delivery options
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days. Delivery estimates start after dispatch, not when an order is placed.

# Tracking
A tracking email is sent when the package leaves the warehouse. If tracking has not updated for 48 hours, contact support with the order number. Orders placed after 2 pm are dispatched the next business day.

title: Northstar equipment handbook
text:
# Warranty
The Trail 200 and Trail 400 have a two-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Proof of purchase is required. Accidental damage, water immersion and ordinary wear are excluded. Replacement parts retain the original warranty end date.

# Repairs
Do not open the sealed battery compartment. A swollen battery must be disconnected from charging and assessed by an authorised repair partner. Support will supply a return authorisation before a repair shipment.

title: Northstar product comparison
text:
# Product specifications
Model | Battery runtime | Weight | Weather resistance
Trail 200 | 8 hours | 310 grams | IP54
Trail 400 | 14 hours | 470 grams | IP65

Runtime is measured at 50 percent brightness and room temperature. Cold weather and maximum brightness reduce runtime. IP65 does not mean a device is safe for immersion. The Trail 400 uses a USB-C charger rated at 20 watts.

title: Northstar account help
text:
# Password resets
Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. A password reset link expires after 20 minutes and can be used only once. Never share passwords or verification codes with support.

# Two-factor authentication
Use an authenticator application to enable two-factor authentication. Save recovery codes in a secure place. If your phone is lost, use a recovery code or contact the account recovery team.

title: Northstar subscription policy
text:
# Cancellation
A monthly subscription can be cancelled at any time from account settings. Access remains available until the end of the paid billing period. The cancellation prevents the next renewal; it does not refund the current period.

# Annual plans
Annual subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before the renewal date. An email reminder is sent 14 days before an annual renewal. Pricing changes are communicated separately.

title: Internal engineering runbook — synthetic
text:
# Staging deployments
The staging environment uses the release-candidate branch. A staging deployment requires a passing test suite and approval from the release lead.

# Rollback
Rollback by selecting the last verified deployment artifact. Do not rebuild an old commit because dependency resolution may differ. The synthetic internal environment identifier is NORTHSTAR-STAGING-42. This fixture demonstrates filtering and contains no real secret.

title: Northstar privacy guide
text:
# Support data retention
Support ticket attachments are deleted 90 days after a ticket is closed. A request to erase an account also schedules removal of associated search index records and cached answers. Legal retention exceptions require a separate review.

# Document updates
Each indexed document carries a source identifier, version and update time. Search results should show the source version so readers can distinguish current guidance from an older copy.
